summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DrugKG Text AI Platform iteration 3. All 10 features tested successfully. Backend APIs (15 tests) passed 100%. Frontend UI flows working correctly including new chatbot feature.
passed_tests: 1. Landing page loads correctly with DrugKG Text AI branding and hero section
2. Navbar shows: Generate button, DrugBank link, About link. When logged in: Dashboard and Admin links appear
3. Footer shows brand name, Platform links (Generate Text, DrugBank, Sign In), About section (Our Mission, Privacy Policy, Contact)
4. Login flow works with admin credentials: drugbankkgtotext@uel.com / drugbank1919
5. Dashboard page loads after login with stats (Total Generations, Avg Latency, Time Saved) and Saved Generations section with empty state
6. Chatbot toggle button visible at bottom-right corner on all pages. Opens chat window. User can type and send messages. AI responds with pharmaceutical knowledge
7. Admin dashboard accessible after admin login - shows stats (5 users, 7 generations), Recent Generations table, System Status (API Online, Database Connected, Model Active), Users list
8. Generate page has Text Input tab and File Upload tab, textarea for input, Generate button, Generated Output section
9. Chat API endpoint POST /api/chat works with message and returns AI response (tested with 3 different queries)
10. Generations API GET /api/generations/my returns array for authenticated user
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. Chatbot uses Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model via HuggingFace API - responses take 5-10 seconds. 401 interceptor in api.js handles expired tokens by redirecting to login.
